about: Hong Kong interim (six-month) and fiscal-year revenue from Eastmoney RPT_HKF10_FN_MAININDICATOR (OPERATE_INCOME; for interims also the year-ago value OPERATE_INCOME_SQ and Eastmoney's own growth OPERATE_INCOME_YOY), filtered to watchlist.json. Amounts as Eastmoney prints them; the CURRENCY label is not stored because it is unreliable. Append-only: a changed number is a new observation, nothing is removed. Written by scripts/fetch-hk-interims.js, read by lib/hk-interim.js.
